[Section] Evaluation and conclusion
[source_id=11] Evaluating creative generation tasks is both critical and complex BIBREF26. Along the lines of previous research on evaluating text generation tasks BIBREF26, we report the perplexity scores of our test set on the evaluated models in the Supplementary Section, Table TABREF4 Our model shows improvements over baseline and GumbelGAN. Common computational methods like BLEU BIBREF27 and perplexity are at best a heuristic and not strong indicators of good performance in text generation models BIBREF28. Particularly, since these scores use target sequences as a reference, it has the same pitfalls as relying on MLE. The advantages in this approach lie in the discriminator's ability to influence the generator to explore other possibilities. Sample outputs for our model can be found on our website .
